terms.comment: Applied here to software; plural vitia. Our existing preferred everyday “bug” is mendum, mendī n.; keeping that choice makes related phrases consistent.

phrases.latin: Mendum est sīcut lapillus quī in calceō tuō latet: nōn bene ambulās, dōnec lapillum invēneris et ējēceris.
phrases.english: A bug is like a pebble hiding in your shoe: you can’t walk properly until you’ve found the pebble and thrown it out.
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam
